summary: Plan climate risk actions for agricultural sourcing, storage, logistics and finance. Explore the course and build practical resilience decision tools.
lede: Climate-resilient agricultural value chain planning helps agribusiness, cooperative and finance teams assess climate exposure and protect supply continuity. For agribusiness managers, cooperative leaders and agricultural finance officers, the course connects risk assessment to decisions across procurement, storage and delivery. Participants map vulnerable chain nodes, plan sourcing and logistics responses, and assess index insurance and resilience financing using the IPCC climate risk framework, ISO 14091 and FAO Climate-Smart Agriculture.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support sourcing, storage, transport, lending and programme decisions across agricultural value chains.
modules: IPCC Climate Risk in Value Chains
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one area of agricultural operations, cooperative management, supply chain logistics, agricultural lending or resilience programming. No coding or programming is required.
